blessings.title: A morning made new
blessings.text: May the mercies that are new this morning meet you at the door of this day; may every good and perfect gift find you, and may His faithfulness be the first thing you see.
blessings.groundingNote: Grounded in LAM 3:22-23, first given to a people rather than an individual; offered here as a blessing (a prayerful wish), not a guarantee.

blessings.title: Over your household
blessings.text: May your house be a heritage of the LORD — a household that chooses, together, to serve Him, and finds that choice to be its peace.
blessings.groundingNote: Grounded in JOS 24:15, first given to a people rather than an individual; offered here as a blessing (a prayerful wish), not a guarantee.

blessings.title: Over the children
blessings.text: May all your children be taught of the LORD, and may great be their peace; may the wisdom you plant in them outlast every season.
blessings.groundingNote: Grounded in ISA 54:13, first given to a people rather than an individual; offered here as a blessing (a prayerful wish), not a guarantee.

blessings.title: Over the covenant of two
blessings.text: May the LORD keep what He has joined; may your home be kept in His blessing, two made one under His countenance.
blessings.groundingNote: Grounded in NUM 6:24, JOS 24:15, first given to a people rather than an individual; offered here as a blessing (a prayerful wish), not a guarantee.

changes: Additional references from the demo's "also" list resolved canonically.

blessings.title: Over the work of your hands
blessings.text: May the works you commit to the LORD be established; may you labour heartily, as unto the Lord and not unto men.
blessings.groundingNote: Grounded in COL 3:23, first given to a people rather than an individual; offered here as a blessing (a prayerful wish), not a guarantee.

blessings.title: Over what is ahead
blessings.text: May He who began a good work in you perform it to the very end; and may your expectation not be cut off.
blessings.groundingNote: Grounded in PHP 1:6, first given to a people rather than an individual; offered here as a blessing (a prayerful wish), not a guarantee.

blessings.title: A covering for the day
blessings.text: May the LORD preserve you from all evil and preserve your soul; may the angel of the LORD encamp round about you.

blessings.title: For every going out and coming in
blessings.text: May the LORD preserve your going out and your coming in, from this time forth and even for evermore; may He be with you in all places whither you go.

blessings.title: When strength is spent
blessings.text: May the LORD uphold you with the right hand of His righteousness, and may His grace be sufficient exactly where you feel weakest.
blessings.groundingNote: Grounded in ISA 41:10, first given to a people rather than an individual; offered here as a blessing (a prayerful wish), not a guarantee.

blessings.title: For decisions ahead
blessings.text: May the God who gives liberally give you wisdom without reproach, and may His word be a lamp to every step you take.
blessings.groundingNote: Grounded in JAS 1:5, first given to a people rather than an individual; offered here as a blessing (a prayerful wish), not a guarantee.

blessings.title: The blessing of peace
blessings.text: May the LORD lift up His countenance upon you and give you peace — the peace Jesus leaves, not as the world gives.
blessings.groundingNote: Grounded in NUM 6:26, JHN 14:27, first given to a people rather than an individual; offered here as a blessing (a prayerful wish), not a guarantee.

blessings.title: A heart that remembers
blessings.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all His benefits — may gratitude rise in you today for every good and perfect gift.
